result.note: ETP balance: treated flow reaching the outfall vs outfall flow (same time). Boundary balance: intake vs outfall + losses + sludge water + tank storage change (reuse cancels). Tank balance: wastewater arriving (estimated from intake) vs ETP inflow + storage change; unaccounted water left the tank another way, or was intake water that never became wastewater. null means a required signal is under 80% coverage.

steps.why: Power far below expected band with normal inflow would show aeration cut versus normal operation.

result.note: Expected band fitted on the factory's normal-operation baseline from ETP inflow; with the ETP off, expected is standby power.

steps.why: Replayed power would hide an aeration cut and must be ruled out before supporting normal operation.

result.note: Live meters never repeat noise exactly; identical readings for hours point to a replayed or copied feed.
